You are expendable. You are not expected to return.

This game is currently in alpha. Expect bugs and the sorts.

Join the group to receive a 10% discount on any and all Dead-Drop Shop purchases.

data.name: Industrialist
data.description:
Industrialist is a factory construction and expansion game inspired by Mindustry, Factorio, and other popular industry simulation games.

Key Game Features:
    • Pollution management: Keep track of your pollution level and keep it under control.
    • Production lines: Plan, optimize, and upgrade your manufacturing systems.
    • Economic strategy: Manage money and research new technology.
    • Immersive mechanics: Engage with immersive and modular machine systems.

This game has a steep learning curve and complex mechanics. Getting used to these systems will require a lot of practice, so we recommend playing with friends to share discoveries.

Development Status:
Beta (v1.0). Expect regular updates, possible bugs, and changes while the game is in development.

data.name: A Core Game
data.description:
!! An update to the game is in the works. Some content is still raw, and unfinished. !!

⚠️ Game servers may be susceptible to "migrating", aka restarting often due to being outdated. Please be aware of that at all times, especially during early releases. This will not usually be in effect though.

Buried deep within an undisclosed mountain range, there's a facility which is (quite literally) just as dumb as it can possibly get. And whoever owns this place? Yeah they seem a little paranoid for a place owned by a lava lamp company.

"A Core Game", or ACG, is supposed to be an accurate representation of your average "core game" on Roblox. Even though this has changed over the past few years, the game still takes inspiration from a few titles of the same genre.

Group: https://www.roblox.com/groups/9486047/Solaris-Development-Group#!/about
